statement: ∀ (a : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (h : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set (V (n+1))), 0 < a → (∀ i, Metric.ediam (U i) = if i < m+1 then ENNReal.ofReal h else 0) → cost a U = ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal h)^a
proof:
intro a m h U ha hdi
rw [cost, tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (m+1)) (fun i hi => by
  rw [hdi, if_neg (by simpa using hi), ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos ha])]
calc
  (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), (Metric.ediam (U i)) ^ a) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m+1), (ENNReal.ofReal h)^a := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hdi, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)]
  _ = _ := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
